QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 1
QuestInfo.0: You're not a beginning anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!
QuestInfo.1: You're not a beginning anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!
QuestInfo.2: Rain's first question was about which hotkey to press to open the Item Inventory. The answer is I!

0.0: Hello! How're you liking Maple World so far? Let me give you a brief rundown of the place, and then I'll give you a quiz. If you answer my questions correctly, I'll give you something handy. Interested?

yes.0: Hehe! Let me warn you, don't underestimate my quiz. There's a lot to learn, so pay attention!
yes.1: You've hunted monsters already. Remember what keys you had to use? #bCtrl to attack#k and #bAlt to jump#k, right? And #bZ to pick up the items#k? #nYou can also use the #rKey Config#k on the bottom right of your screen to recalibrate the buttons to your liking.
yes.2: But what you haven't experienced yet is Job Advancement. To become a more powerful traveler, you need a job! To get one, you'll first have to leave this place, Maple Island, and head to Victoria Island. You need to be at least at level #b10#k to become a Warrior, Bowman, or Thief, and at least level #b8#k to be a Magician. Each job has its pros and cons, so choose carefully.
yes.3: I didn't tell you EVERYTHING you need to know for the quiz, so make sure to focus. Ready for the questions?

no.0: Hmm, you could learn a lot through my quiz. I think you should try it!

1.0:
What do you press to open the item inventory? 

#L0##b I#l
#L1# K#l
#L2# S#l
#L3# E#k#l
1.1: That's right! To open up the item inventory, you press #rI#k.

0.1: K is for the Skill Window. You'll be able to use skills once you get yourself a job. Don't you remember the shortcut key for the, ahem, i-tem inventory?
0.2: No, no. S is to check out your stats and your Ability Points. Come on, think!
0.3: Eh? E is to check out your equipment. Try again.
